outcome: severe maternal outcomes (ICU admission, delivery for respiratory compromise)
newborn admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 77 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection who were admitted to 12 Italian maternity hospitals between February 23 and March 28, 2020.
finding: One in five hospitalized pregnant women with COVID-19 experienced severe maternal outcomes (urgent delivery for respiratory compromise or ICU admission), and increased pregestational BMI and abnormal heart and respiratory rates on admission were associated with severe disease.
